'''Antiprions''' were a medicine used to combat [[Prion/Legends|prions]]. The surgeon on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], [[Kornell Divini|Uli]], noted that despite the antiprions, [[Antibiotic/Legends|antibiotics]], and [[Anti-virus|anti-virals]], an old [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] patient still remained sick.<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
